error.emailShape: That does not look like an email address. Check it.
error.passwordShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.

auth.lead: Pick your projects back up where you left them.
auth.leadRegister: A few minutes and Ariadne starts remembering for you.
auth.tagline: Your thread through the project's context.

profile.title: How you work
profile.note: The agent receives this text at the start of every session. You can edit it now and later in settings.

q1.label: ROLE
q1.hint: Junior frontend developer, learning by building
q1.question: What do you do?

q3.label: WORK STYLE
q3.hint: Explain the decisions, not just the code. The simplest thing that works wins.
q3.question: How do you want to work?

q4.label: LANGUAGE
q4.hint: Talk in English, write code and comments in English
q4.question: Which language do we talk in?

profile.optionalAnswer: You can leave this empty, then this part stays out of the profile.
profile.previewEmpty: What you type shows up here. The agent receives this text at the start of every session.

project.title: First project

hint.name: ariadne-core
hint.limits: What this project deliberately does not do

project.joinInstead: Joining somebody else's team? I have an invitation code

error.name: A project needs a name.
error.repoTaken: You already have a project for this repository.

project.previewEmpty: The card grows as you fill it in. The agent reads it on every question about this project.

agent.title: Connect your agent
agent.label: YOUR AGENT
agent.what: This command adds Ariadne to your agent as a memory source. The token is embedded in it and never touches your repository.
agent.where: Paste it in a terminal and press Enter. Not using a terminal? Skip this step, the app works without an agent.
agent.tokenOnce: You see this token now and never again. A lost token is replaced with a new one in settings.
agent.tokenFailed: The token was not generated, so the command is not ready. Try again.

other.note: There is no ready-made command for this agent. Point it at the MCP server at {url} with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying the token below.

agent.copyUnavailable: Copying is unavailable. Select the command and copy it by hand.
agent.tokenWhat: This is your token. Give it to the agent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
agent.tokenWhere: Copy it now. Once you leave this screen you will not see it again.

key.title: Your Gemini key

lead.none: Ariadne uses Gemini for two things: turning entries into vectors so they can be searched, and writing the answers to your questions. Without a key neither works, and the chat goes quiet without saying why.
lead.server: The server already has a key, so you can skip this step. Add your own if you would rather your requests were billed to you.
lead.user: This account already has a key. Type a new one to replace it.

key.optional: You can skip this and add the key later in settings.

common.failed: That did not work. Try again.
common.noGeminiKey: There is no Gemini key, so Ariadne can neither answer nor record an entry. Add one in settings.

home.stale: Data from {at}. The server is not responding, so it may be out of date.

empty.title: No project yet
empty.note: A project is where Ariadne keeps decisions and agreements. Create your first one to start.

home.askTitle: What do you want to know?
home.memoryLine: Ariadne answers from {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} recorded in this project.
home.decisionsEmptyNote: The first ones arrive on their own once an agent finishes a session. You can also write one yourself under Add to memory.
home.waitingEmptyNote: When an agent or a conversation proposes a change, it shows up here.

remembers.label: REMEMBERS
remembers.title: Ariadne remembers
remembers.body: You tell Ariadne about the project's decisions, agreements and constraints. Each one is recorded with its date and its source, so you can check later where it came from.

answers.label: ANSWERS
answers.title: Ariadne answers
answers.body: Later you ask why something was done or what you agreed on. The answer is built only from recorded entries, and you see which ones underneath it.

youDecide.label: YOU DECIDE
youDecide.title: You decide
youDecide.body: Nothing enters the project's memory without your say-so. Every proposal waits on the To approve screen until you accept it or reject it.

assistant.placeholder: What would you like to ask?
assistant.nothingRecorded: Nothing has been recorded about this yet.
assistant.hint: Enter sends, Shift + Enter starts a new line
assistant.sourcesCount: {count, plural, one {Based on # entry} other {Based on # entries}}
assistant.nothingRecordedNote: Ariadne only answers from recorded context, so it does not guess. You can add this under Add to memory.
assistant.suggest2: Why did we choose this stack?
assistant.suggest3: What constraints does this project have?
assistant.historyEmptyNote: Ask your first question and the conversation stays here, so you can come back to it.

database.title: Add to memory
database.note: Write what changed. Nothing is saved straight away: you get proposals to approve.
database.placeholder: E.g. We switched the form library from X to Y, because...
database.lead: Describe a decision or an agreement. Ariadne records it straight away, because you are the one writing it.
database.hint: Enter sends, Shift + Enter starts a new line
database.suggest1: We switched the form library from X to Y.
database.suggest2: We are not using a backend; the app stays static.
database.nothingProposedNote: Ariadne found nothing in this that needs recording or correcting.
database.historyEmpty: You have not added any context yet.
database.historyEmptyNote: Describe your first decision or change, and the whole run of it stays here.

pending.title: To approve
pending.empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
pending.emptyNote: When an agent or a conversation proposes a change, it shows up here.
pending.toastConfirmed: Entry added to the project context.
pending.toastFailed: That did not work. Try again.

project.title: Project
project.repoFixed: Fixed: this is the address an agent recognises the project by.
project.graphEmpty: The map appears once there are entries.
project.graphHint: Click a card to read the full entry.
project.aboutEmpty: No description. Say in one sentence what this project is for.
project.limitsNote: The agent reads this before every session.
project.limitsEmpty: No constraints. Put the rules the agent should follow here.
project.graphLead: Oldest to newest. Solid line: a shared file. Dashed: similar content. Drag and zoom.
project.graphEmptyNote: Every recorded entry is a card on the map, and the links compute themselves.
project.unreachableNote: The project could not be loaded. Check that the Ariadne server is running and try again.
project.noProjectNote: Create a project on the overview screen and its card will appear here.
project.graphErrorNote: The server did not answer the map request. Your entries are safe; try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Account, what agents may do, tokens and team.
settings.accountErrorNote: Account settings could not be loaded. Check that the Ariadne server is running and try again.
settings.profileNote: The agent is given this text at the start of every session.

geminiState.user: Ariadne embeds and answers on your key. Requests from this account are billed to you at Google.
geminiState.server: Ariadne runs on the server's key. Add your own if you would rather pay for your own requests.
geminiState.none: There is no key at all, so recording entries and both chats do not work. Add one to turn them on.

settings.geminiNote: The key is encrypted before it is stored and never comes back from the server.
settings.autoApproveIsOff: Edits and removals an agent asks for wait in the queue for your decision. New entries always go to the queue, whatever this is set to.
settings.autoApproveIsOn: An agent corrects and archives entries on the spot, without asking. New entries still wait for approval.
settings.tokensLead: One token connects one agent to one archive. You see it once, when it is created.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy it now, it is not shown again
settings.tokenOnceWhere: Paste it into your agent's configuration, where it asks for the Ariadne token.
settings.tokensEmptyNote: Create one to connect Claude Code or another agent to this memory.
settings.teamLead: An archive belongs to a workspace, not to a person. Everyone in the workspace reads and writes the same context, over MCP as well.
settings.inviteEmailNote: Give an address and the code works only for it. Leave it empty for a code anyone can use.
settings.inviteWhere: Send it to the person you are inviting. They paste it below, under I have an invitation code.
settings.newWorkspaceNote: A separate archive with its own projects and its own people.
settings.joinCodeNote: Paste the code somebody on the team sent you.

conflict.title: CONTRADICTION
conflict.lead: This entry clashes with something already in memory. Both cannot be true at once, so say which one stands. The other does not disappear: it is marked as overruled and keeps a link to what replaced it.

done.new: The older entry is marked as overruled.
done.old: The new entry is marked as overruled.
